subject.title: fix(zalo): add timeouts to Bot API requests

question: Should every ordinary Zalo Bot API operation, including media and webhook calls, fail after a fixed 30-second client-side deadline by default?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish the mechanical behavior, but the acceptable deadline for all existing Zalo workloads is a channel-policy choice rather than a testable correctness fact.

options.title: Adopt the 30-second default
options.body: Accept bounded failure for all ordinary Zalo API requests and merge the current implementation after normal merge gating.

options.title: Use operation-specific internal deadlines
options.body: Keep long polling separate and define different bounded deadlines for operations such as media uploads if maintainers expect valid requests to exceed 30 seconds.

options.title: Retain current behavior
options.body: Decline the global default deadline and pursue a narrower reliability change only if a concrete affected operation is identified.

recommendation.title: Adopt the 30-second default
recommendation.body: Accept bounded failure for all ordinary Zalo API requests and merge the current implementation after normal merge gating.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work in the same Zalo polling reliability path makes this the best available routing candidate, though current API ownership remains uncertain.
